tasks.title: Project scaffold: pyproject.toml & package structure
tasks.description: Create the pyproject.toml with project metadata, entry point, and dependency config (stdlib only, uv-managed). Also create the src/spenny/__init__.py package init file so the package is importable.

tasks.title: Storage layer: load/save JSON persistence
tasks.description: Implement src/spenny/storage.py with the ExpenseRecord and ExpenseData TypedDicts, plus load() and save() functions. load() creates an empty store if the file is missing, exits with code 1 on corrupted JSON. save() pretty-prints with 2-space indent. Amounts are stored/loaded as strings.
verify: python -c "from spenny.storage import load, save, ExpenseData, ExpenseRecord"

tasks.title: Core business logic: add, list, delete, summarize
tasks.description: Implement src/spenny/core.py with pure functions: add_expense(), list_expenses(), delete_expense(), and summarize(). Defines SummaryResult NamedTuple. Per the audit finding, the CLI must always supply an explicit date string; if date is None the core raises ValueError to stay pure. Amounts use decimal.Decimal throughout. Filtering is inclusive on date ranges.
verify: python -c "from spenny.core import add_expense, list_expenses, delete_expense, summarize, SummaryResult"

tasks.title: CLI entry point: argparse subcommands
tasks.description: Implement src/spenny/cli.py with main() wiring argparse subcommands (add, list, delete, summary) to core functions. The CLI supplies datetime.date.today() as the date string when none is provided by the user, satisfying the purity constraint. Formats output tables, confirmation messages, and error messages exactly as shown in spec examples. All printing and sys.exit calls live here only.

tasks.title: Tests: storage layer
tasks.description: Write tests/test_storage.py covering load() with a missing file (auto-creates empty store), load() with valid JSON, load() with corrupted JSON (exits code 1), save() writes pretty-printed JSON with string amounts, and round-trip fidelity.

tasks.title: Tests: core business logic
tasks.description: Write tests/test_core.py covering: add_expense with valid inputs, zero/negative amount raises ValueError, empty category raises ValueError, date=None raises ValueError, list_expenses with no filter, category filter, start/end date filter, combined filters, delete_expense success, delete_expense with missing ID raises KeyError/ValueError, summarize with no expenses (has_expenses=False), summarize with expenses and no filter, summarize with date range filter that matches nothing (has_expenses=True, totals empty), overall total computation.

tasks.title: Tests: CLI integration
tasks.description: Write tests/test_cli.py using subprocess or unittest.mock to exercise the CLI end-to-end: spenny add creates an expense and prints confirmation, spenny list prints table, spenny list --category filters, spenny list --start-date/--end-date filters, spenny delete removes and confirms, spenny summary shows per-category and overall totals, spenny summary --start-date/--end-date filters, invalid inputs produce error messages and exit code 1, missing expenses.json is auto-created.
